data.body:
[P2] Include preparation waits in cancellation reporting

Cancellation while `adapter.prepare` is running raises from this shielded await before entering the case's cancellation handler. Consequently, waiting cases never call `emit`, and profile finalization cannot publish their quarantine or retirement diagnostics because they are absent from `completed`. A live run can leave a quarantined deployment without any corresponding result audit records. Handle cancellation around preparation as well as case execution, emitting an infrastructure-error result before re-raising. Add a test that cancels a run during blocked preparation.
